title: A flickered unit token keeps its size
notes: R444, R175: a unit token Flickered keeps the X/X it was summoned at (and the Bread Token's Armor), as one a Reborn brings back does, where the reset had made it a printed 0/0 that died at once: under a Radiant Shadowstep it flickered again and the board never settled. R57, R1300: Radiant Shadowstep remakes each hand copy from its definition, carrying the token's summoned X/X, Armor and tuning explicitly without carrying the Chinese flag; add_to_hand's true copyOf path also carries a Bread Token's Armor (summon's copy already did). R1185002: a token Set Stats resized returns Flickered or Reborn as it was summoned, with none of the tuning that made a Radiant Ghoul wear the set size. The classifier's unforced games show Lava Golem (core-055), The Rock (core-066), the Core tokens (core-t, claimed through the Bread Token, core-t-bread), Keymaster Keenus (meditative-065) and Harmony Spirit (meditativeplus-021) playing differently; the Bread Token, the Ghoul Token and Shadowstep are the cards the rule is about, and a forced game of Shadowstep alone shows no divergence.

player.title: Flickered tokens keep their size
fixes: A token summoned at a size (the Bread Token's 5/5 and its Armor) keeps it when it is Flickered, instead of coming back as a 0/0 that dies at once.
Radiant Shadowstep's copies of a flickered token carry its size and Armor too.
A Radiant Ghoul Token that Harmony Spirit set to a size returns, Flickered or brought back by Reborn, at the size it was summoned (doubled), not the size it was set to.
